title: Shin Megami Tensei
sources: own RAM search with gbaverify on this ROM (no RA notes for this translated hash): the hero's character-creation screen (HP 20/20, St 16 In 6 Ma 7 Vi 5 Ag 7 Lu 5 after spending points) matched a record at 0x02037C40

widgets.text: Hero, Heroine and allies + recruited demons

Negotiate with demons to recruit them (talk in battle)
Fuse demons at the Cathedral of Shadows

Talk instead of fight to recruit; MAG is spent to summon
Demons have affinities; fuse for stronger ones
Kichijoji, Shinjuku, Roppongi, Ginza...; first-person dungeons

Weapons, guns + bullets, armor; Macca (money), MAG
MAG is spent to keep demons summoned; Macca buys equipment and healing

Demons recruited/fused
Demons recruited by talking or made by fusion; the demon compendium keeps them

Story events; ending depends on alignment
Choices tilt you to Law, Neutral or Chaos; the alignment decides the ending route
English translation in the Translations folder; version Hotfix 2 (from the file name)

notes: found on the character-creation screen only (not yet in the game proper): HP/max HP u16 at 0x02037C40/42, MP/max MP 0x02037C44/46, base stats St/In/Ma/Vi/Ag/Lu bytes 0x02037C50-55 (a second copy at +8 holds the effective values); a mirror exists in IWRAM at 0x030045D8
